content.short: Orchid is a decentralized VPN infrastructure and protocol.
content.description: Orchid was founded by four technologists—Dr Steven Waterhouse, Jay Freeman, Gustav Simonsson, and Brian J. Fox—and is now based in Berlin and San Francisco. It is an on-chain privacy protocol that lets users distort their location and manage access to their accounts across multiple devices. The Web3-native project accepts payments in crypto or fiat and provides apps for Mac, iOS, and Android, enabling broad accessibility for privacy-preserving connectivity.
